composite_stone_anchors.name: Composite Stone Anchors
composite_stone_anchors.observation: A stone stock with wooden stakes driven through it bites into the sand where a plain stone would drag.

harbor_dues_by_cargo.name: Harbor Dues by Cargo
harbor_dues_by_cargo.observation: The harbor keeper counts each ship's jars and bales and takes a share for the upkeep of the quay.
harbor_dues_by_cargo.social_consequence: Merchants grumble on the quay, but the dues keep its stones mended.

brailed_square_sail.name: Brailed Square Sail
brailed_square_sail.observation: Lines run from the yard down to the deck, so the crew can shorten sail in a squall without climbing aloft.
brailed_square_sail.ability_reason: A sail that can be shortened from the deck lets ships keep the sea in weather that once held them ashore.

traveling_balance_kits.name: Traveling Balance and Weights
traveling_balance_kits.observation: Merchants carry a folding balance and a case of nested weights, and settle each bargain on the spot.

timber_rafting.name: Timber Rafting
timber_rafting.observation: Felled trunks are lashed into rafts far upriver and ridden down to the towns on the spring flood.
timber_rafting.social_consequence: Forests no one here has walked now fall for our roofs, and the rafters drown in the spring rapids.

rutted_rock_roadbeds.name: Rock-cut Road Ruts
rutted_rock_roadbeds.observation: Through the passes the road is cut into the living rock, and the wheels run in grooves worn deeper every year.

deep_hold_merchantmen.name: Deep-hold Merchantmen
deep_hold_merchantmen.observation: Broad, round-bellied ships carry a village's worth of grain and jars in a single hold.
deep_hold_merchantmen.ability_reason: One deep hull does the work of a fleet of coasters, and whole harvests can now move by sea.

camel_caravans.name: Camel Caravans
camel_caravans.observation: Camels that drink once in many days carry their loads across the waterless country between the wells.
camel_caravans.ability_reason: The desert stops being a wall and becomes a road for those who keep camels.

desert_water_stages.name: Desert Water Stages
desert_water_stages.observation: Cisterns cut a day's march apart let caravans cross the dry country without carrying all their water.

mule_breeding.name: Mule Breeding
mule_breeding.observation: Mares put to donkey stallions foal mules, stronger than asses and surer-footed than horses on the mountain tracks.

mounted_messengers.name: Mounted Messengers
mounted_messengers.observation: Riders carry sealed letters along set routes, changing horses where the stations keep them.

merchant_ship_convoys.name: Seasonal Merchant Convoys
merchant_ship_convoys.observation: Merchant ships sail together when the season opens, so no lone hull meets raiders or a storm by itself.

weighed_silver_payment.name: Weighed Silver Payment
weighed_silver_payment.observation: Cut pieces of silver weighed on the merchant's balance settle debts between strangers who have no goods to swap.

coastal_trading_colonies.name: Coastal Trading Colonies
coastal_trading_colonies.observation: Our people found small towns on far coasts to buy, store and ship for the home harbor.
coastal_trading_colonies.social_consequence: Kin who settle abroad take up foreign ways, and the home town must defend what it cannot see.

forward_supply_depots.name: Forward Supply Depots
forward_supply_depots.observation: Before an army marches, grain and fodder are carried ahead and stored in guarded depots along its road.

paved_ship_haulway.name: Ship Haulway
paved_ship_haulway.observation: A paved track across the neck of land lets crews drag ships on greased runners from one sea to the other.

paired_quarter_rudders.name: Paired Quarter Rudders
paired_quarter_rudders.observation: Two steering oars hung at the stern and joined by a bar let one helmsman hold a heavy ship on course.

money_changers.name: Money Changers
money_changers.observation: At the harbor and the market, changers sit at their tables and swap one town's silver and coin for another's, at a fee.

coin_count_trade.name: Coins Taken by Count
coin_count_trade.observation: Stamped coins of known weight pass from hand to hand by count, and no one unpacks a balance at every stall.
coin_count_trade.ability_reason: Coin taken by count makes every market faster and lets small sellers deal with strangers.

trunk_road_courier_relay.name: Courier Relay on the Trunk Road
trunk_road_courier_relay.observation: Riders hand the dispatch bag on at fixed day-stages, and news crosses the realm in days instead of weeks.
trunk_road_courier_relay.ability_reason: Orders and reports now outrun armies; the realm can be governed from one center.

framed_camel_saddle.name: Framed Camel Saddle
framed_camel_saddle.observation: A wooden frame over the hump spreads the load, so a camel carries more and a rider can sit and fight from its back.

trunk_canals.name: Trunk Canals
trunk_canals.observation: Long canals join one river system to the next, and barges carry grain between basins that never met.
trunk_canals.social_consequence: Canal diggers are drafted by the thousand, and the still water breeds fever along its banks.

touchstone_testing.name: Touchstone Testing
touchstone_testing.observation: A streak of metal drawn across the black stone shows a trained eye whether the gold or silver is good.

sounding_lead.name: Sounding Lead
sounding_lead.observation: A lead weight armed with tallow is dropped overboard, and the sand or shell it brings up tells the pilot where he is.

small_change_coins.name: Small Change Coins
small_change_coins.observation: Little bronze coins buy a loaf or a cup, so the poorest can trade with money instead of favors.
small_change_coins.social_consequence: Neighbors who once traded favors now settle in coin, and old obligations fade.
small_change_coins.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Struck Copper Coins from refined copper and charcoal, using wrought iron and stone. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

written_sailing_directions.name: Written Sailing Directions
written_sailing_directions.observation: Scrolls list each harbor, its landmarks, its water and the days of sailing to the next.

written_freight_contracts.name: Written Freight Contracts
written_freight_contracts.observation: A written contract names the cargo, the day of delivery and the penalty if the shipper fails.

harbor_masters.name: Harbor Masters
harbor_masters.observation: A harbor master gives each ship its berth and its turn to load, and the quays stop clogging.

voyage_partnerships.name: Voyage Partnerships
voyage_partnerships.observation: Several merchants share one ship's cargo, profit and risk, so no single wreck ruins a house.

tide_reckoning.name: Tide Reckoning
tide_reckoning.observation: Pilots reckon the tide by the moon and bring deep ships over the bar only at high water.

deposit_transfer_orders.name: Deposit Transfer Orders
deposit_transfer_orders.observation: A merchant leaves his silver with a banker and pays others by written order, and no coin changes hands.
deposit_transfer_orders.ability_reason: Money now moves on a written word, and large trade no longer waits on carried silver.

general_average_jettison.name: Shared Jettison Losses
general_average_jettison.observation: When cargo is thrown overboard to save a ship, every owner aboard bears a share of the loss.

breast_strap_harness.name: Breast-strap Harness
breast_strap_harness.observation: A strap across the chest instead of the throat lets a horse pull hard without choking.

lead_hull_sheathing.name: Lead Hull Sheathing
lead_hull_sheathing.observation: Thin lead sheets nailed over the hull keep the shipworm out and the planks sound for many seasons.

grain_receipt_banks.name: Grain Receipts
grain_receipt_banks.observation: Farmers deposit grain in the state stores and pay their debts with the sealed receipt instead of the sacks.

flash_lock_gates.name: Flash-lock Gates
flash_lock_gates.observation: A gate in the weir is opened, and boats ride the rush of water down or are hauled up against it.

duty_free_harbor.name: Duty-free Harbor
duty_free_harbor.observation: A harbor that takes no dues draws ships from every coast, and the town grows rich on what their crews spend.
duty_free_harbor.social_consequence: Foreign crews crowd the harbor streets; the town grows rich and a little less its own.

transcontinental_relay_trade.name: Long Relay Trade
transcontinental_relay_trade.observation: Goods pass from people to people along one great road, and cloth woven beyond the farthest mountains reaches our markets.
transcontinental_relay_trade.ability_reason: Our markets now touch peoples no one here has ever seen, and their goods and their sicknesses arrive together.

raked_bow_foresail.name: Bow Foresail
raked_bow_foresail.observation: A small sail on a mast raked out over the bow helps the helmsman bring the ship's head round.

frontier_customs_posts.name: Frontier Customs Posts
frontier_customs_posts.observation: At the border, officials open the bales and take a share of every cargo that crosses.
frontier_customs_posts.social_consequence: Traders learn the smugglers' paths, and the customs men learn to take bribes.

district_road_crews.name: District Road Crews
district_road_crews.observation: Each district must keep its own stretch of road, and crews fill the ruts before the rains.
district_road_crews.social_consequence: Villages along the road owe it days of labor, and resent the duty at harvest.

seasonal_wind_crossings.name: Seasonal-wind Crossings
seasonal_wind_crossings.observation: Pilots who know the winds that turn with the seasons sail straight across open ocean and back within the year.
seasonal_wind_crossings.ability_reason: Ships no longer need the sight of land; far coasts come within a single season's sailing.

pivoting_front_axle.name: Pivoting Front Axle
pivoting_front_axle.observation: The wagon's front axle turns on a pin, so a long loaded wagon can take a bend in the road.

ship_bilge_pumps.name: Bilge Pumps
ship_bilge_pumps.observation: A pump worked by the crew clears the bilge, and a leaking ship stays afloat to reach harbor.

stage_animal_hire.name: Stage Animal Hire
stage_animal_hire.observation: At each road station a traveler can hire a fresh mule or cart by the day and hand it in at the next.

raised_floor_warehouses.name: Raised-floor Warehouses
raised_floor_warehouses.observation: Great public warehouses stand on raised floors with vented walls, and grain keeps dry through a wet year.

great_bulk_freighters.name: Great Bulk Freighters
great_bulk_freighters.observation: Huge freighters, each carrying the grain of a whole province, sail between the great harbors.
great_bulk_freighters.ability_reason: A city can now be fed from harvests across the sea, and it comes to depend on them.
great_bulk_freighters.social_consequence: The capital eats grain from across the sea; one lost sailing season means hunger at home.

state_post_passes.name: State Post and Travel Passes
state_post_passes.observation: Officials carrying a sealed pass may claim fresh mounts, food and lodging at every station on the road.
state_post_passes.ability_reason: The realm's officers travel on the state's own horses and bread; its reach is the length of its roads.
state_post_passes.social_consequence: Villages near the road must feed the post's horses and riders, and they hate the pass-bearers.

state_grain_fleets.name: State Grain Fleets
state_grain_fleets.observation: Shipowners sail on contract to carry the state's grain to the capital, and are paid for every sack delivered.

iron_hoof_boots.name: Iron Hoof Boots
iron_hoof_boots.observation: An iron sole strapped over the hoof keeps a draft animal sound on stone roads.

treadwheel_quay_cranes.name: Quay Treadwheel Cranes
treadwheel_quay_cranes.observation: Men walking inside a great wheel lift loads from the hold onto the quay, and a ship is emptied in a day.

lighter_transshipment.name: Lighter Transshipment
lighter_transshipment.observation: Where the river mouth is too shallow, small lighters carry the freighter's cargo up to the city wharves.

painted_cargo_labels.name: Painted Cargo Labels
painted_cargo_labels.observation: Every jar bears painted marks naming its contents, its weight, its shipper and the year.

post_horse_studs.name: Post-horse Studs
post_horse_studs.observation: State stud farms breed and rest horses, so the post stations never lack a fresh mount.

strap_suspended_carriages.name: Strap-hung Carriages
strap_suspended_carriages.observation: The carriage body hangs from leather straps on its frame, and travelers ride long days without bruising.

common_trade_coin.name: Common Trade Coin
common_trade_coin.observation: One coin of known weight and face passes in every province and among many foreign peoples.

oasis_caravan_cities.name: Oasis Caravan Cities
oasis_caravan_cities.observation: Walled cities at the oases shelter and supply the caravans, and grow rich on the traffic.

coopered_cargo_casks.name: Coopered Casks
coopered_cargo_casks.observation: Staves bent and bound with hoops make casks that roll, stack and never shatter as jars do.

single_wheel_barrow.name: Wheelbarrow
single_wheel_barrow.observation: One wheel and two handles let a single carrier move a load that took two with a litter.

road_itineraries.name: Road Itineraries
road_itineraries.observation: Written lists give every station along the realm's roads and the distance between them.

graded_wagon_classes.name: Wagon Classes by Load
graded_wagon_classes.observation: Wagons are graded by the load they may carry, and the heaviest are kept off the soft roads.

transit_bond_seals.name: Transit Bond Seals
transit_bond_seals.observation: Goods sealed at one frontier cross the realm under bond and pay no duty until they are sold.

distant_payment_letters.name: Distant Payment Letters
distant_payment_letters.observation: A merchant's letter orders his agent in a far market to pay the bearer, and no silver travels the road.

canal_boat_slipways.name: Canal Slipways
canal_boat_slipways.observation: Boats are hauled up a paved slope from one canal level to the next by oxen at a windlass.

fore_and_aft_sail.name: Fore-and-aft Sail
fore_and_aft_sail.observation: A triangular sail set along the ship's length lets it work close into the wind instead of waiting for a fair one.
fore_and_aft_sail.ability_reason: Ships stop waiting in harbor for the right wind; sailing seasons lengthen and voyages shorten.

strip_route_maps.name: Strip Route Maps
strip_route_maps.observation: A long strip map shows each road as a line, with its towns, stations and rivers marked in order.

river_toll_stations.name: River Patrol and Toll Stations
river_toll_stations.observation: Patrol boats at the toll stations keep the barges moving and take the river's due from each.
